scenes.name: 咖啡店点单
scenes.setting: 工作日的早晨，街角咖啡店排着队。你只想快点拿到咖啡，别迟到。

lines.en: Hi there! What can I get started for you?
lines.zh: 你好！想喝点什么？
lines.note: get started for you 是美国咖啡店的固定问法，字面是「开始给你做」。不是问你要不要开始。

lines.en: Could I get a large latte, please?
lines.zh: 我要一杯大杯拿铁，谢谢。
lines.note: 点单说 Could I get… 比 I want… 礼貌得多，也不用想 Would you… 后面接什么。

lines.en: Sure. Hot or iced?
lines.zh: 好的。热的还是冰的？

lines.en: Iced, please. And could you make it with oat milk?
lines.zh: 冰的。能换成燕麦奶吗？

lines.en: We can. That'll be fifty cents extra, is that okay?
lines.zh: 可以。要加五毛钱，行吗？
lines.note: That'll be + 金额，是店员报价格式，听到就知道该掏钱了。

lines.en: That's fine. Oh, and could I get a blueberry muffin too?
lines.zh: 没问题。对了，再来一个蓝莓麦芬。

lines.en: For here or to go?
lines.zh: 在这儿喝还是带走？
lines.note: 英式说 eat in or takeaway，意思一样。

lines.en: To go, please. Can I pay by card?
lines.zh: 带走。可以刷卡吗？

lines.en: Of course. What name should I put on the cup?
lines.zh: 当然。杯子上写什么名字？

lines.en: Wen. W-E-N. Thanks a lot.
lines.zh: Wen，W-E-N。多谢。

phrases.en: Could I get a large latte, please?
phrases.tip: 点单万能句，换掉最后的名词就能点任何东西。

phrases.en: For here or to go?
phrases.tip: 店员必问的一句，听不懂就卡在这儿。

phrases.en: That'll be five dollars.
phrases.tip: 报价格式，后面接金额。

phrases.en: Could you make it with oat milk?
phrases.tip: make it with… 换配料，餐厅里同样能用。

scenes.name: 街头问路
scenes.setting: 你在陌生城市找一家药店，手机没电了，只能问人。

lines.en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you. Is there a pharmacy near here?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，不好意思。附近有药店吗？
lines.note: sorry to bother you 是开口第一句的缓冲垫，不说这句直接问会显得突兀。

lines.en: Sure. Go straight down this street and take the second left.
lines.zh: 有。沿这条街一直走，第二个路口左转。

lines.en: The second left. Is it far?
lines.zh: 第二个路口左转。远吗？

lines.en: Not at all, about five minutes on foot. It's next to the bank.
lines.zh: 不远，走路大概五分钟。就在银行旁边。
lines.note: on foot＝步行。走路五分钟说 five minutes on foot，不说 by walk。

lines.en: Great. Is it open on Sundays?
lines.zh: 好。周日开门吗？

lines.en: I think so, until six. If it's closed, there's another one by the station.
lines.zh: 应该开，到六点。要是关了，车站那边还有一家。

lines.en: That's really helpful. Thank you so much.
lines.zh: 帮了大忙，太谢谢了。

lines.en: No problem. Have a good one!
lines.zh: 不客气，过得愉快！
lines.note: Have a good one 是美式口语告别，比 Have a nice day 更随意。

phrases.en: Sorry to bother you, but…
phrases.tip: 向陌生人开口的标准开头。

phrases.en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
phrases.tip: near here 结尾比 nearby 更自然。

phrases.en: Take the second left.
phrases.tip: 路口用 take，不用 turn at。

phrases.en: It's about five minutes on foot.
phrases.tip: 距离用 on foot 计时。

scenes.name: 电梯里的寒暄
scenes.setting: 你搬进新公寓一个月，今天在电梯里撞见了邻居。

lines.en: Morning! Nasty weather today, isn't it?
lines.zh: 早啊！今天天气真糟糕，是吧？
lines.note: 用反义疑问句开启闲聊是英语世界的通用做法，对方只需应一声。

lines.en: Tell me about it. I got soaked walking here.
lines.zh: 可不是嘛，我走过来全身都湿了。
lines.note: Tell me about it 不是「跟我说说」，而是强烈赞同＝「太对了」。

lines.en: Are you new to the building? I don't think we've met.
lines.zh: 你是新搬来的吧？我们好像没见过。

lines.en: I moved in last month, unit 302. I'm Wen.
lines.zh: 我上个月搬来的，302。我叫 Wen。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Wen. I'm Dan, 405. How's the flat working out?
lines.zh: 幸会，Wen。我是 Dan，405。房子住着怎么样？
lines.note: How's … working out 是问「结果如何／顺不顺利」，比 How is it 更自然。

lines.en: So far so good, apart from the noise from the street.
lines.zh: 到目前还好，就是街上有点吵。
lines.note: apart from＝除了。这个短语一出，抱怨也显得客气。

lines.en: Yeah, that takes some getting used to. I'm on the fourth floor if you ever need anything.
lines.zh: 是啊，这得适应一阵。有需要就上四楼找我。
lines.note: take some getting used to＝需要时间适应，固定搭配。

lines.en: That's kind of you. See you around!
lines.zh: 你人真好。回头见！

phrases.en: Nasty weather, isn't it?
phrases.tip: 闲聊开场，说完把话头递给对方。

phrases.en: Tell me about it.
phrases.tip: 表示强烈同意，不是字面的「跟我说说」。

phrases.en: So far so good.
phrases.tip: 被问近况时最省力的回答。

phrases.en: That takes some getting used to.
phrases.tip: 评价任何新鲜事物都能用。

scenes.name: 机场值机
scenes.setting: 国际航班起飞前两小时，你在值机柜台前，行李有点多。

lines.en: Good morning. May I see your passport and booking reference?
lines.zh: 早上好。请出示护照和订票号。

lines.en: Here you go. I'm checking in for the flight to Seattle.
lines.zh: 给你。我要办去西雅图那班的值机。
lines.note: Here you go 是递东西时最自然的说法，比 Give you 强得多。

lines.en: Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
lines.zh: 您要靠窗还是靠走廊？
lines.note: aisle 读 /aɪl/，s 不发音。

lines.en: An aisle, please. I like to stretch my legs.
lines.zh: 靠走廊吧，我喜欢伸伸腿。

lines.en: How many bags are you checking in today?
lines.zh: 今天托运几件行李？

lines.en: Just the one. Is it within the weight limit?
lines.zh: 就一件。没超重吧？

lines.en: It's fine. Any liquids or electronics in there?
lines.zh: 没问题。里面有液体或电子产品吗？

lines.en: No, just clothes. What time does boarding start?
lines.zh: 没有，只有衣服。几点开始登机？

lines.en: Boarding begins at 9:20 at gate B14. Please be there thirty minutes before departure.
lines.zh: 9:20 在 B14 登机口开始登机。请提前三十分钟到。

lines.en: Got it. Thank you for your help.
lines.zh: 明白了，谢谢。

phrases.en: Here you go.
phrases.tip: 递护照、递钱、递手机都用这句。

phrases.en: I'm checking in for the flight to Seattle.
phrases.zh: 我要办去西雅图那班的值机。
phrases.tip: check in for + 航班，动词短语别拆开。

phrases.en: Is it within the weight limit?
phrases.tip: 行李、快递都能用。

phrases.en: What time does boarding start?
phrases.tip: 问时间用 What time does…start，比 When 更具体。

scenes.name: 酒店入住
scenes.setting: 晚上九点，你拖着行李箱走进预订好的酒店大堂。

lines.en: Good evening. Do you have a reservation with us?
lines.zh: 晚上好。您有预订吗？

lines.en: Yes, under the name Chen, for three nights.
lines.zh: 有，姓陈，住三晚。
lines.note: 订房、订位都用 under the name…，即「登记在这个名字下」。

lines.en: Let me check. Yes, a double room, checking out on Friday. Could I see your ID?
lines.zh: 我查一下。对，一间大床房，周五退房。可以看一下您的证件吗？

lines.en: Sure. Is breakfast included?
lines.zh: 可以。含早餐吗？

lines.en: It is, served from seven to ten on the second floor. Here's your key card, room 508.
lines.zh: 含，二楼，七点到十点。这是您的房卡，508。

lines.en: Great. Is there Wi-Fi in the room?
lines.zh: 好。房间里有 Wi-Fi 吗？

lines.en: Yes, the password is on the back of the key card. The lift is just around the corner.
lines.zh: 有，密码在房卡背面。电梯就在拐角。

lines.en: One more thing, could I get a late checkout tomorrow?
lines.zh: 还有件事，明天能晚点退房吗？

lines.en: We can do one o'clock for a small fee. I'll put a note on your booking.
lines.zh: 一点退房可以，收一点费用。我在您订单上备注一下。

lines.en: Perfect, thanks a lot.
lines.zh: 太好了，多谢。

phrases.en: Under the name Chen.
phrases.tip: 订房、取包裹、餐厅订位通用。

phrases.en: Is breakfast included?
phrases.tip: 订房必问，价格常常不含早餐。

phrases.en: Could I get a late checkout?
phrases.tip: late checkout 是固定说法，别说 leave later。

phrases.en: One more thing, …
phrases.tip: 追加要求前的过渡，比 and also 自然。

scenes.name: 餐厅点菜
scenes.setting: 你和朋友坐在餐厅里，菜还没点，你有坚果过敏。

lines.en: Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes?
lines.zh: 可以点菜了吗，还是再看一会儿？

lines.en: A few more minutes, please. What do you recommend?
lines.zh: 再看一会儿。有什么推荐吗？

lines.en: The grilled salmon is very popular tonight, and the mushroom soup is a house special.
lines.zh: 今晚烤三文鱼很受欢迎，蘑菇汤是本店招牌。

lines.en: I'll have the salmon. Could I get the sauce on the side?
lines.zh: 那我要三文鱼。酱汁能单独放吗？
lines.note: on the side＝另装在小碟里，不加在菜上。点菜高频。

lines.en: Of course. And to drink?
lines.zh: 当然。喝点什么？

lines.en: Just still water, thanks. Oh, I'm allergic to nuts, does this dish contain any?
lines.zh: 白水就行。对了，我对坚果过敏，这道菜里有吗？
lines.note: allergic to + 名词。过敏在国外餐厅是必须能说清的一句。

lines.en: Let me check with the kitchen and I'll let you know.
lines.zh: 我去问问后厨，然后告诉您。

lines.en: Thank you. Excuse me, could we get the bill? And could we split it?
lines.zh: 谢谢。不好意思，麻烦结账。可以分开付吗？

lines.en: Certainly. Card or cash?
lines.zh: 可以。刷卡还是现金？

lines.en: Card. Everything was delicious, thank you.
lines.zh: 刷卡。菜很好吃，谢谢。

phrases.en: What do you recommend?
phrases.tip: 看不懂菜单时的救命句。

phrases.en: Could I get the sauce on the side?
phrases.tip: on the side 适用于任何配料。

phrases.en: I'm allergic to nuts.
phrases.tip: allergic to，介词固定用 to。

phrases.en: Could we get the bill, please?
phrases.tip: 美式 the check，英式 the bill，都能听懂。

scenes.name: 退换货
scenes.setting: 上周买的外套拉链坏了，你带着电子收据回到店里。

lines.en: Hi, how can I help you today?
lines.zh: 你好，需要什么帮助？

lines.en: I bought this jacket last week, but the zip is broken. I'd like to return it.
lines.zh: 我上周买了这件外套，拉链坏了。我想退掉。

lines.en: Do you have the receipt with you?
lines.zh: 您带收据了吗？

lines.en: I have it on my phone. Will that do?
lines.zh: 手机里有电子收据。这样可以吗？
lines.note: Will that do? ＝这个行不行？口语里极常用，比 Is that okay 更地道。

lines.en: That's fine. Would you like a refund or an exchange?
lines.zh: 可以。您想退款还是换货？

lines.en: An exchange, if you have it in a medium.
lines.zh: 换一件吧，有 M 码吗？

lines.en: Let me check the stock. We have one in navy. Would you like to try it on?
lines.zh: 我查一下库存。有一件藏青色的。要试一下吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. Where's the fitting room?
lines.zh: 好的。试衣间在哪？

lines.en: Just over there. Take your time.
lines.zh: 就在那边。慢慢试。

lines.en: It fits well. I'll take this one, thanks for your help.
lines.zh: 挺合身，就这件吧，谢谢。

phrases.en: Will that do?
phrases.tip: 口语里替代 Is that acceptable，短而自然。

phrases.en: I'd like to return it.
phrases.tip: 退货 return，换货 exchange，退款 refund，别混。

phrases.en: Do you have it in a medium?
phrases.tip: in + 尺码／颜色，是问库存的固定搭配。

phrases.en: Would you like to try it on?
phrases.tip: try on 的宾语是衣服，代词要放中间：try it on。

scenes.name: 看医生
scenes.setting: 喉咙痛了四天，越来越严重，你去了社区诊所。

lines.en: Come on in and have a seat. What brings you in today?
lines.zh: 进来坐吧。今天哪里不舒服？
lines.note: What brings you in 是医生的标准开场，字面是「什么把你带来的」。

lines.en: I've had a sore throat for about four days, and it's getting worse.
lines.zh: 我喉咙痛了四天左右，越来越严重。
lines.note: 病程用现在完成时：I've had … for four days。说 I have 会被理解为刚开始。

lines.en: Any fever or cough?
lines.zh: 发烧或咳嗽吗？

lines.en: A slight fever last night, thirty-eight degrees. No cough.
lines.zh: 昨晚有点低烧，三十八度。没咳嗽。

lines.en: Let me take a look. It's quite red. Are you allergic to penicillin?
lines.zh: 我看一下。挺红的。你对青霉素过敏吗？

lines.en: I don't think so, but I'm not completely sure.
lines.zh: 应该不过敏，但我不太确定。

lines.en: Then I'll prescribe something milder. Take it three times a day after meals.
lines.zh: 那我开点温和的。一天三次，饭后吃。

lines.en: How long will it take to feel better?
lines.zh: 多久能好？

lines.en: You should see a difference in two or three days. If the fever comes back, come straight back in.
lines.zh: 两三天就该有起色。要是又发烧，直接回来找我。

lines.en: Thank you, doctor. I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: 谢谢医生，太感谢了。

phrases.en: What brings you in today?
phrases.tip: 医生开场白，听懂就不用慌。

phrases.en: I've had a sore throat for four days.
phrases.tip: 描述病程用现在完成时 + for。

phrases.en: I'm allergic to penicillin.
phrases.tip: 看病必须能说的一句。

phrases.en: Three times a day after meals.
phrases.tip: 医嘱固定表达，听到就知道怎么吃药。

scenes.name: 求职面试
scenes.setting: 你面试一家做产品的公司，岗位是前端工程师，聊到第三轮。

lines.en: Thanks for coming in. Tell me a little about yourself.
lines.zh: 谢谢你来。简单介绍一下自己吧。

lines.en: I've been working as a front-end developer for three years, mostly on internal tools.
lines.zh: 我做前端开发三年了，主要做内部工具。
lines.note: 「做了三年」用 I've been working，不用 I work，否则听起来像一直在同一状态。

lines.en: What made you want to apply here?
lines.zh: 为什么想来我们这儿？

lines.en: I've followed your product for a while, and I'd like to work on something more user-facing.
lines.zh: 我关注你们产品有一阵了，想做一些更贴近用户的东西。

lines.en: What would you say is your biggest weakness?
lines.zh: 你觉得你最大的不足是什么？

lines.en: I tend to take on too much on my own. I've started asking for help earlier, but it's still a work in progress.
lines.zh: 我容易一个人扛太多。现在会早点开口求助，但还在改。
lines.note: a work in progress＝还在改进中。谈缺点时的体面收尾，不等于是借口。

lines.en: And how do you handle tight deadlines?
lines.zh: 遇到很紧的截止日期怎么处理？

lines.en: I break the work down and flag risks early, rather than hoping it'll be fine.
lines.zh: 我会把活拆开、尽早把风险讲出来，而不是指望最后没事。

lines.en: Good. Do you have any questions for us?
lines.zh: 好。你有什么想问我们的吗？

lines.en: Yes, what does success look like in this role in the first six months?
lines.zh: 有，这个岗位头半年做到什么样算成功？
lines.note: 反问环节最加分的一句：What does success look like…

phrases.en: Tell me a little about yourself.
phrases.tip: 面试第一句，等于「两分钟自我介绍」。

phrases.en: I've been working as a … for three years.
phrases.tip: 现在完成进行时，强调持续到现在。

phrases.en: It's still a work in progress.
phrases.tip: 承认不足但不自毁的说法。

phrases.en: What does success look like in this role?
phrases.zh: 这个岗位做到什么样算成功？
phrases.tip: 反问环节的万能句。

scenes.name: 客服电话
scenes.setting: 你十天前订的显示器还没到，物流页面停在上周四。你打了客服。

lines.en: Thank you for calling. How may I assist you today?
lines.zh: 感谢来电，请问有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: Hi, I ordered a monitor ten days ago and it still hasn't arrived.
lines.zh: 你好，我十天前订了一台显示器，到现在还没到。

lines.en: I'm sorry about that. Could I have your order number?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。可以给我订单号吗？

lines.en: It's 88214. The tracking page hasn't updated since last Thursday.
lines.zh: 88214。物流页面从上周四就没更新过。
lines.note: since + 时间点，配现在完成时。这是电话里说清问题的关键结构。

lines.en: I see the parcel is stuck at the depot. I'll open a claim with the courier.
lines.zh: 我看到包裹卡在站点。我向快递公司提个查件。

lines.en: How long will that take? I need it for work.
lines.zh: 要多久？我工作要用。

lines.en: Two to three business days. If it isn't found by then, we'll send a replacement.
lines.zh: 两到三个工作日。如果那时还没找到，我们补发一台。

lines.en: Could you email me once there's an update?
lines.zh: 有进展能发邮件告诉我吗？

lines.en: Of course. I've noted that on your account. Is there anything else?
lines.zh: 当然，我在您账户上备注了。还有其他事吗？

lines.en: No, that's all. Thanks for your help.
lines.zh: 没有了，谢谢。

phrases.en: How may I assist you?
phrases.tip: 客服开场，听到就知道接通了人工。

phrases.en: It hasn't updated since last Thursday.
phrases.tip: since + 时间点，句子用现在完成时。

phrases.en: Two to three business days.
phrases.tip: business days 不含周末，问清这点能少等两天。

phrases.en: Could you email me once there's an update?
phrases.zh: 有进展能发邮件告诉我吗？
phrases.tip: once＝一……就，比 when 更紧。
